@@ -56,12 +57,13 @@
 
 
   The 2023 study tests ATCC27405=DSM1237 Cthe_0347 Pfp=ABN51585.1 and Cthe_0349 Aldoa=ABN51587.1, distinct from
-  DSM1313. Synthetic codon-optimized pRSET-A constructs contain N-terminal His6 plus a linker and were expressed
-  in E. coli T7 Shuffle. Ni purification does not identify physiological nickel use. Pfp forward MS at50C used2mM
-  PPi,2.115mM S7P and2.5mM MgCl2. Reported S7P Km3.236mM exceeds the highest measured2.12mM; Vmax is6.294±3.723micromol/min/mg.
-  The F6P Km0.075mM and Vmax100.222±11.6 were measured separately. This preparation/strain/assay difference from
-  the2020 values remains unresolved. Mixed S7P/F6P lowered FBP formation, consistent with competition in that assay,
-  without a direct binding constant. Only forward S7P phosphorylation was tested.
+  DSM1313. Aldoa uses a synthetic codon-optimized pRSET-A construct with N-terminal His6/linker; Pfp uses pAHCT0347/pRSET-A
+  with an N-terminal His6 tag. Both were expressed in E. coli T7 Shuffle. The inspected Pfp-specific passages do
+  not establish a linker or codon optimization. Ni purification does not identify physiological nickel use. Pfp
+  forward MS at50C used2mM PPi,2.115mM S7P and2.5mM MgCl2. Reported S7P Km3.236mM exceeds the highest measured2.12mM;
+  Vmax is6.294±3.723micromol/min/mg. The F6P Km0.075mM and Vmax100.222±11.6 were measured separately. This preparation/strain/assay
+  difference from the2020 values remains unresolved. Mixed S7P/F6P lowered FBP formation, consistent with competition
+  in that assay, without a direct binding constant. Only forward S7P phosphorylation was tested.
